description: Design ranked hybridization probes for a target sequence, returning up to max_probes top-ranked probes (default: additive library-heuristic score; parameters.Ranking = Primer3Penalty: Primer3 internal-oligo penalty p_obj_fn, sourced). Probes longer than thermodynamic_screen_max_length (default 60 = THAL_MAX_ALIGN; opt-in up to 10000) use Primer3's alignment-mode self_any/self_end (<= 12) self-dimer screen plus an inverted-repeat hairpin screen.

parameters.description: Optional probe-design parameters (lengths, Tm range, GC range, max homopolymer, self-complementarity threshold; Ranking = AdditiveScore (default, library heuristic) or Primer3Penalty (Primer3 internal-oligo p_obj_fn around OptTm / OptLength)). Defaults to Microarray when null.

thermodynamic_screen_max_length.description: THAL_MAX_ALIGN of the ntthal thermodynamic self-structure screen: longest A/C/G/T probe (nt) screened by ntthal self-dimer / 3' self-dimer / hairpin Tm (ProbeParameters.ThermodynamicScreenMaxLength; null = the parameters' value, default 60 = Primer3). Opt-in 61..10000 screens longer probes with the unchanged ntthal recursions (= thal.c compiled with -DTHAL_MAX_ALIGN); cost grows as n^2 per probe.

probes.description: Probe records, score-descending (default) or Primer3-penalty-ascending (Ranking = Primer3Penalty, with primer3Penalty).

errors.message: Target sequence cannot be null or empty
